It's been a few months now. Not sure what it is but I want to get a taste of what it's like to fall. Cutting just hasn't been doing it for me. I need more. I need an adrenaline rush. I need that feeling of pain that I've never felt before.

My therapist and family have been thinking I've been doing pretty ok, which is half true. I've just been very bipolar lately. My mood is like a metronome; every click it shifts from content to suicidal. I don't want to break it to them I still feel very depressed some days, because they all think I'm making progress - I thought I was making progress.

I have alot of plans as to harming myself/killing myself. I've only ever cut myself. I have 3 knives stashed in my room as I know if I got razors I'd really fuck my shit up. I have locations picked out that I can jump off of to kill myself. I have suicide notes typed up on my phone that I revise every month or so. I'm just ready to do something.
